comment.text: ZNF516 A256 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.

An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting ZNF516 residue A256 have been observed in clear cell renal cell carcinoma, papillary renal cell carcinoma, and adrenocortical carcinoma.
